properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: JWT signing secret key. Must be at least 256 bits (32 characters) long. Must be set via environment variable JWT_SECRET.

properties.name: app.jwt.expiration
properties.description: JWT token expiration time in milliseconds. Default is 86400000 (24 hours).

properties.name: wechat.app-id
properties.description: WeChat Mini Program App ID. Must be set via environment variable WECHAT_APP_ID.

properties.name: wechat.app-secret
properties.description: WeChat Mini Program App Secret. Must be set via environment variable WECHAT_APP_SECRET.
